title: The World's Largest-Scale Full-Size Humanoid Robot Real-Time Livestream Performance
title_zh: 全球最大规模全尺寸人形机器人实时直播表演
abstract: At the Opening Ceremony of WorldSkills Shanghai 2026 on September 22, 19 Unitree humanoid robots performed alongside 120 dancers, presenting the world's largest-scale performance featuring full-size general-purpose humanoid robots before an audience of more than 10,000 people, with a fully AI-driven autonomous robot cluster performance live-streamed worldwide in real time.
abstract_zh: 2026年9月22日上海世界技能大赛开幕式上，19台宇树科技人形机器人与120名舞者同台演出，呈现了全球最大规模的全尺寸通用人形机器人表演，现场观众超过一万人，全程由AI驱动的自主机器人集群表演向全球实时直播。
tldr_zh: 19台宇树人形机器人与舞者同台，AI集群表演全球直播。
cover_zh: 19台人形机器人组团跳舞｜全程AI自主，全球直播！
